# Roberto Segura Sala

> From Cuenca, father of two. Engineer responsible for the data platform at Audiense. Apache Iceberg and Trino over a 15 TB+ lake with 20+ streaming consumers, real-time enrichment with Kafka/Redpanda, and applied ML on top: LoRA-tuned embeddings and cross-encoder reranking served with vLLM on Kubernetes. Engineer since 2011.

Job title: Backend, Big Data & Real Time Engineer at Audiense (Jan 2021 – present).
Contact and profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/robersegsal/ · https://github.com/rsegura · https://x.com/Rober_Segura
